EmailTemplate.subject: Make us an extension of your campus
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Remember that our Customer Success Team is here to support your international students and families. With offices around the globe, 19 languages spoken, and near 24x7 support, we can remove the burden of complex, country-specific questions off your plate.
Our team is made up of real people with real industry expertise. We are happy to connect to your students and families via phone, email, or live chat. Just send them to our intuitive Help Center <[[http://flywire.com/help]]> for quick access to all our support channels.
Meet the team, starting with Douglas:
Who am I? I’m Douglas Teo from Singapore. I graduated from the University of London and love playing tennis and badminton.
Where am I based? Singapore
What’s my favorite thing about supporting your international payers? I love being part of a company that helps people from around the world maneuver a process that would normally be complex and frustrating. I’m excited to be a part of their journey.
As always, let us know if you have any questions.
